r2_base_url.description: Cloudflare R2 public bucket root URL with trailing slash for direct asset delivery.

worker_base_url.description: Cloudflare Worker gateway root URL with trailing slash (/manifest, /json/*, /files/*).

use_worker_routes.description: When true, routes relative asset paths through worker_base_url + /files/{path}; when false, uses r2_base_url directly.
